findings.body: The new row-level expectations fix much of the prior gap, but the oracle still does not retain every populated Actual column. The generated fixture supplies values for `Month`, `MIS GL Name`, and `ContraAct`, while the `actual.rows` schema has no fields for them; the test asserts only that those headers exist. A later importer could blank or alter those cell values and still satisfy this oracle, so it does not provide the required independent all-column source expectations.
findings.title: Not done: unconditional generated-source oracle

findings.body: The declared BASELINE scope excludes `plans/**` and `.factory/**`, but this branch adds the full story plan, cold-read record, approval metadata, and task review state. None is consumed by the baseline implementation or its tests, and they describe the wider multi-stage story rather than this task. The prior scope issue therefore remains in the new evidence even though the previously cited specification file is absent; split these four out-of-scope artifacts into their owning planning change.
findings.title: Keep unrelated story-planning artifacts out of the BASELINE change
